```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = TRUE,
  message    = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  fig.width  = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi        = 150
)

required_packages <- c(
  "lme4",         # GLMM engine (user-mandated)
  "lmerTest",     # p-values for lme4
  "performance",  # Diagnostics and VIF
  "readxl",       # Excel ingestion
  "dplyr",        # Data manipulation
  "tidyr",        # Reshaping
  "stringr",      # String operations
  "ggplot2",      # Visualizations
  "knitr",        # Tables
  "kableExtra"    # Table styling
)

installed  <- rownames(installed.packages())
to_install <- setdiff(required_packages, installed)
if (length(to_install) > 0) {
  install.packages(to_install, repos = "[https://cloud.r-project.org](https://cloud.r-project.org)", quiet = TRUE)
}

invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
set.seed(42)

DATA_PATH <- "Data/trainData.xlsx"

# Read directly from Excel source
df_raw <- read_excel(DATA_PATH)
cat("Raw shape:", nrow(df_raw), "rows ×", ncol(df_raw), "columns\n")

# Rectify corrupted UTF-8 strings before ANY filtering occurs
df_raw <- df_raw |>
  mutate(
    property_type = case_when(
      property_type == "propri√©t√©" ~ "propriété",
      property_type == "ch√¢teau"    ~ "château",
      property_type == "terrain √† b√¢tir" ~ "terrain à bâtir",
      TRUE ~ property_type
    )
  )

cat("\nRepaired property types:\n")
print(table(df_raw$property_type[df_raw$property_type %in% c("propriété", "château")]))

KEEP_TYPES <- c(
  "appartement", "maison", "villa", "propriété",
  "duplex", "ferme", "loft", "chalet"
)

df <- df_raw |> filter(property_type %in% KEEP_TYPES)

group_map <- c(
  "appartement" = "apartamento",
  "duplex"      = "apartamento",
  "loft"        = "apartamento",
  "maison"      = "casa",
  "villa"       = "casa",
  "ferme"       = "casa",
  "chalet"      = "casa",
  "propriété"   = "lujo"
)

df <- df |>
  mutate(
    property_group = factor(group_map[property_type],
                            levels = c("apartamento", "casa", "lujo"))
  )

cat("Group distribution after mapping:\n")
print(table(df$property_group))

# 1. Base transformations
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    log_price   = log(price),
    log_size    = log(size),
    departement = str_sub(as.character(postal_code), 1, 2),
    pg_casa     = as.integer(property_group == "casa")
  )

# 2. Structural Imputation: floor & nb_bathrooms
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    floor_missing        = as.integer(is.na(floor)),
    floor_clean          = if_else(is.na(floor), 0, as.numeric(floor)),
    nb_bathrooms_missing = as.integer(is.na(nb_bathrooms)),
    nb_bathrooms_clean   = if_else(is.na(nb_bathrooms), 0, as.numeric(nb_bathrooms))
  )

# 3. Eradication of unstable features
# land_size removed entirely to prevent slope bias on casa/lujo
df <- df |> select(-any_of(c("land_size")))

# Drop NAs from remaining critical predictors (e.g., nb_rooms, nb_bedrooms)
df <- df |> drop_na(size, nb_rooms, nb_bedrooms)

cat("Final row count before split:", nrow(df), "\n")
split_stratified <- function(data, strat_col, test_size = 0.2, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  data |>
    group_by(across(all_of(strat_col))) |>
    mutate(.fold = sample(
      c("train", "test"),
      size    = n(),
      replace = TRUE,
      prob    = c(1 - test_size, test_size)
    )) |>
    ungroup()
}

df_split <- split_stratified(df, "property_type")
train_df <- df_split |> filter(.fold == "train") |> select(-.fold)
test_df  <- df_split |> filter(.fold == "test")  |> select(-.fold)

cat("Train shape:", nrow(train_df), "| Test shape:", nrow(test_df), "\n")
# Compute means EXCLUSIVELY from training data
TRAIN_MEANS <- list(
  log_size = mean(train_df$log_size, na.rm = TRUE),
  lat      = mean(train_df$approximate_latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
  lon      = mean(train_df$approximate_longitude, na.rm = TRUE)
)

add_centred_features <- function(data, means) {
  data |>
    mutate(
      log_size_c = log_size - means$log_size,
      lat_c      = approximate_latitude  - means$lat,
      lon_c      = approximate_longitude - means$lon,
      
      # Retaining size interactions, dropping spatial interaction
      log_size_x_nb_terraces = log_size_c * nb_terraces,
      log_size_x_pg_casa     = log_size_c * pg_casa,
      floor_x_apt            = floor_clean * as.integer(property_group == "apartamento")
    )
}

train_df <- add_centred_features(train_df, TRAIN_MEANS)
test_df  <- add_centred_features(test_df,  TRAIN_MEANS)
FIXED_EFFECTS <- c(
  "log_size_c", "lat_c", "lon_c", 
  "floor_clean", "floor_missing", "floor_x_apt",
  "nb_bathrooms_clean", "nb_bathrooms_missing",
  "nb_rooms", "nb_bedrooms",
  "nb_parking_places", "nb_boxes", "nb_photos", 
  "nb_terraces", "has_a_balcony", "has_a_cellar", 
  "has_a_garage", "has_air_conditioning", "last_floor",
  "pg_casa", 
  "log_size_x_nb_terraces", "log_size_x_pg_casa"
)

# Build formula mathematically
fe_formula_str <- paste("log_price ~", paste(FIXED_EFFECTS, collapse = " + "))
full_formula   <- as.formula(paste(fe_formula_str, "+ (1 + log_size_c | departement)"))

cat("Fitting LMM via lme4::lmer...\n")
cat("Formula:", deparse(full_formula), "\n")

# Fit the GLMM using lmer
model_lmer <- lmer(full_formula, data = train_df, REML = TRUE)

summary(model_lmer)
cat("Checking VIF for fixed effects...\n")
vif_res <- check_collinearity(model_lmer)
print(vif_res)
# Predict conditional on random effects
test_df$pred_log_price <- predict(model_lmer, newdata = test_df, allow.new.levels = TRUE)
test_df$pred_price     <- exp(test_df$pred_log_price)

# Metrics
rmse_log <- sqrt(mean((test_df$log_price - test_df$pred_log_price)^2))
mae_eur  <- mean(abs(test_df$price - test_df$pred_price))
mape     <- mean(abs((test_df$price - test_df$pred_price) / test_df$price)) * 100

cat("\n=== TEST SET PERFORMANCE ===\n")
cat("RMSE (Log):", round(rmse_log, 4), "\n")
cat("MAE (€):   ", formatC(mae_eur, format="f", digits=0, big.mark=","), "€\n")
cat("MAPE (%):  ", round(mape, 2), "%\n")
```
